text:
incident-bot: Pager alert — Dedicated pool titans-vpc-01 node gpu-78 reporting repeated PCIe/IO errors and ECC spikes. Affected tenant: AegisCorp (VPC). Errors started 2026-03-17T10:12:30Z. Auto-fallback to reserve pool attempted and partially succeeded; some requests returned 500/timeout. Paging oncall: ryan.

ryan: ack, on my way.

ben: taking on-call. Can someone confirm customer impact and whether we should isolate the node?

elliot: I see elevated 500s in the edge logs for AegisCorp. Pausing new model launches for that tenant now.

maya: quick look at host logs: NVMe I/O errors and repeated PCIe link resets on gpu-78. Sample from dmesg: `[10:12:31] pcieport 0000:01:00.0: AER: Uncorrected (Non-Fatal) error received: ID 0000` and `nvme0n1: I/O 0 QID 0 timeout, aborting command`. Could be hardware or underlying spot node preempt behaviour.

rack-ops-bot: Ticket RACK-4321 opened for physical inspection / RMA. On-call rack ops assigned: calendar window in ~15m.

ryan: plan: 1) isolate tenant traffic from gpu-78 (no new allocations) 2) gracefully drain in-flight jobs where possible 3) migrate long-running jobs to reserved-pool-02 4) if in-flight checkpoints are at risk, coordinate with customer for safe abort.

ben: running isolation now: `redwoodctl tenant-isolate --tenant AegisCorp --node gpu-78` executed.

ben: cordon node to prevent scheduling: `redwoodctl node cordon gpu-78` -> success.

elliot: started routing switch to reserved-pool-02. ~63% of requests are now served from reserve; still seeing ~4% errors for short-lived in-flight requests. Streaming endpoints show partial reconnects.

maya: BMC shows healthy but GPU host logs show repeated link flaps. I recommend RMA if BMC reboot doesn't clear it. ETA for hardware swap if needed ~4 hours (vendor SLA).

ryan: customer comms: @elliot please DM AegisCorp ops with current mitigation steps and ETA. Ask if they can delay non-critical model checkpoints for 1 hour.

elliot: DM sent. AegisCorp responded: "We see elevated 500s since 10:13; confirm safe to abort current training checkpoints?" I asked for a short hold while we migrate jobs; awaiting reply.

ben: migrating in-flight jobs: `redwoodctl job migrate --from-node gpu-78 --to reserved-pool-02 --grace 30s` — started. A few jobs hit forced-evict after 45s due to stuck IO.

incident-bot: Update: node gpu-78 marked unschedulable, 87% of tenant traffic moved. QoE degrading but no SLO breach yet. If errors >5% for 15m escalate to sev2.

rack-ops-bot: BMC reboot triggered now. Will report back in 2m.

maya: BMC reboot completed. NVMe errors still present, PCIe resets continue. RMA approved.

ryan: handing off hardware ownership to @maya (RMA + post-swap verification). I'll stay on customer comms and monitoring. If platform wants to run a rollback plan to hosted models, flag it here.

elliot: acknowledged. I'll keep the customer updated every 30 minutes and notify if we need to failover to hosted endpoints.

ben: created internal incident page and postmortem ticket PM-2026-88. Saved logs: `/var/log/sre/gpu-78/dmesg.log`, `/var/log/sre/gpu-78/nvme.log`, `/var/log/redwood/tenants/AegisCorp/*.log`. Tagging incident with tenant=AegisCorp and pool=titans-vpc-01.

maya: RMA scheduled with vendor for same-day swap; tech ETA 3.5h. After swap we'll run `redwoodctl node verify gpu-78 --smoke` and `redwoodctl run perf-bench --node gpu-78` before re-enabling scheduling.

ryan: thanks all. Handoff summary: isolation and partial migration done, hardware RMA in flight, customer notified, incident page https://redwood.internal/incidents/3865432100 created. Staying on until RMA complete.

incident-bot: Final note logged at 3865432380. React with :thumbsup: when you've pulled logs into the postmortem ticket.
